text: The fix has four parts, because a single alert tweak would only patch one symptom of a deeper gap.
checkout-api now tracks its own business outcome directly -- orders succeeded or failed -- and a new alert watches that failure rate, independent of HTTP status.
A synthetic canary runs a real sandboxed checkout against VoltPay every three minutes, so a problem is caught even during a quiet overnight lull.
Marcus flags the visibility gap to Lin Chao's team, and the group adds a permanent review step so every future alert gets checked against this exact blind spot.
Next: turning this incident into a story leadership can actually act on.
